title: Governments Response Towards INC
definition: The official policy, attitudes, and counter-strategies adopted by the British colonial administration in India toward the Indian National Congress (INC) from its inception in 1885 through the Moderates and Extremists phases up to 1917, shifting from initial benign tolerance to systematic hostility and repression.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Prelims (chronology of British Viceroyalties, repressive acts, safety valve theory) and Mains GS-1 (evolution of Indian nationalism, colonial counter-strategies, divide and rule policies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Governments Response Towards INC.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Moderate Phase of Indian National Movement
Viceroyalties of Dufferin, Curzon, and Minto
